lessons.title: Teacher's Book
lessons.intro: Each surah is one card. Fill in the questions of each section; teachers will see them as cards at /guru.
lessons.empty: No surahs yet. Add the first surah to start entering questions.

lesson.deleteBody: {{title}} and its {{count}} sections will be deleted. The super admin can restore them from the recycle bin for 30 days.
lesson.name: Surah name
lesson.pickHint: Search by surah name or number

sectionPage.new: This section is still empty. Add questions below and save.
sectionPage.deleteBody: This section and all its questions will be deleted. The super admin can restore it from the recycle bin for 30 days.
sectionPage.noReading: No reading. Add the du'a, hadith or text teachers read before answering.
sectionPage.previewNote: This is how teachers will see this section. Unsaved changes are shown too.

question.matchHint: For each row on the left, pick its correct match on the right. Teachers see the right-hand options shuffled.
question.explanationHint: Shown to the teacher after answering.

cards.empty: No questions in this section yet.
cards.wrong: Not quite. The correct answer is marked green.

access.title: Admin access
access.intro: Invite the admins who run the learning platform. They sign in with Google using the email you invite.
access.isSuper: That is the super admin's account.
access.already: {{email}} is already a learning platform admin.
access.failed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
access.invited: {{email}} can now open the learning platform. Send them this message:
access.message:
Assalamu'alaikum,

You have been invited as an admin of the Markaz Tadarus learning platform.

Open {{link}} and sign in with Google using {{email}}.
access.none: No admins yet. Only the super admin can open this platform.
access.removeBody: {{email}} will no longer be able to open the learning platform. Any site dashboards they have stay as they are.
